svg.title: Zone options for the mini golf city
svg.desc: To-scale plan of the auditorium with the confirmed runway, its possible extension, estimated cables, an assumed audience zone, the booth sightline, and three candidate golf zones with gross areas.
svg.text: Where a “city” course could go: three zones, now that the runway is confirmed
To scale (20 px = 1 m). Measured values are marked “measured”; everything else is an estimate or a guess to confirm. The runway is raised, so nobody walks across it:
the two floor halves only connect beyond its tip (x 31.2 → booth). If the dashed extension is built, that open floor shrinks from ≈ 20.7 m to ≈ 12.1 m deep.
Keep props ≤ 1.5 m: booth sightline to the stage (to confirm)
possible extension, est. ±1 m, not confirmed
Dark blocks along the top wall: doors or exits? (to confirm)
Other vertical drops cross both halves every few metres: not mapped, see source screenshots.
x (m) from the stage-end wall · room 54.7 × 27.1 m (planning-tool tooltip)
Long and thin (46 × 11.6 m): forces a line.
Shares the floor with the audience zone.
Option B: Plaza at the runway tip
≈ 505 m² gross; ≈ 484 m² as a U if the extension is built
The only square-ish floor (19.7 × 25.6 m); both halves
meet here. Away from the countdown crowd.
Booth sightline and two drops cross it.
Option C: U around the runway
Most floor, but the runway splits it: the halves
only join beyond the tip. Takes floor from the party
Wi-Fi AP + data cable (est.; floor or rigged?)
Source: floorplan/auditorium-dimensions.json and floorplan/source-screenshots/ · drops and Wi-Fi points scaled off screenshots 01 and 04 (≈ ±1 m) · regenerate with tools/make_zone_options.py
